search_people.title: Search people
search_people.description: Search Apollo's database of net-new people (prospects not yet saved as contacts) by title, seniority, location, employer domain, headcount, revenue, technologies, job postings and growth. Consumes no credits and returns no emails or phone numbers - enrich a result with enrich_person to get those. Use search_contacts for people already saved to your team. Up to 100 per page, 500 pages.

person_titles.description: Job titles; a person matches if they hold any one, e.g. ["sales manager", "vp marketing"].

include_similar_titles.description: Set false to return only exact title matches for person_titles (default true).

q_keywords.description: Free-text keywords to filter people by.

q_person_name.description: A person's name; results contain every word entered.

person_locations.description: Where people live: cities, US states or countries, e.g. ["california", "ireland"].

person_seniorities.description: Current seniority levels: owner, founder, c_suite, partner, vp, head, director, manager, senior, entry, intern.

organization_locations.description: Headquarters locations of the person's current employer (cities, US states, countries).

organization_domains.description: Employer domains, without www. or @, up to 1,000, e.g. ["apollo.io"].

not_organization_domains.description: Exclude people whose current employer has any of these domains.

contact_email_status.description: Email statuses: verified, unverified, likely to engage, unavailable.

organization_ids.description: Apollo organization ids of employers to include.

organization_num_employees_ranges.description: Employer headcount ranges as "min,max" strings, e.g. ["1,10", "250,500"].

revenue_min.description: Minimum employer revenue, a plain integer with no currency or commas.

revenue_max.description: Maximum employer revenue, a plain integer with no currency or commas.

technologies_all.description: Technology uids the employer uses ALL of, e.g. ["salesforce", "google_analytics"] (underscores for spaces).

technologies_any.description: Technology uids the employer uses ANY of.

technologies_none.description: Exclude employers using any of these technology uids.

job_posting_titles.description: Job titles in the employer's active job postings.

job_posting_locations.description: Locations of the employer's active job postings.

num_jobs_min.description: Minimum number of active job postings at the employer.

num_jobs_max.description: Maximum number of active job postings at the employer.

headcount_growth_months.description: Window for headcount growth: 6, 12 or 24 months. Needed for the growth range.

headcount_growth_min.description: Minimum employer headcount growth over the window, whole percent.

headcount_growth_max.description: Maximum employer headcount growth over the window, whole percent.

lookalike_organization_ids.description: Organization ids to use as lookalike seeds; returns people at similar companies.

output.description: Matching people and the total count.

enrich_person.title: Enrich a person
enrich_person.description: Match one person in Apollo's database from any identifying details (email, name plus employer or domain, LinkedIn URL or Apollo id) and return their enriched profile, including work email. Optionally reveals personal emails and phone numbers. Consumes credits (1 for demographics/email, +8 for a mobile) and does not save a contact - use create_contact for that. Use enrich_people_bulk for up to 10 at once.
enrich_person.notes: Consumes Apollo credits when data is found.

first_name.description: The person's first name, used with last_name.

last_name.description: The person's last name, used with first_name.

name.description: Full name, instead of first_name and last_name.

hashed_email.description: MD5 or SHA-256 hash of the person's email.

organization_name.description: Name of the person's current or previous employer.

domain.description: Employer domain without www. or @, e.g. apollo.io.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Also return personal emails (consumes credits; not available for GDPR regions).

reveal_phone_number.description: Also return phone numbers including mobiles; delivered asynchronously to webhook_url or by polling. Consumes credits.

run_waterfall_email.description: Run email waterfall enrichment across third-party sources (async).

run_waterfall_phone.description: Run phone waterfall enrichment across third-party sources (async).

webhook_url.description: Where Apollo posts phone/waterfall results; required with reveal_phone_number unless poll_only is true.

poll_only.description: Receive phone/waterfall results by polling get_webhook_result with the returned request_id instead of a webhook.

output.description: The matched person, plus a request_id for async phone/waterfall results.

enrich_people_bulk.title: Bulk enrich people
enrich_people_bulk.description: Enrich up to 10 people in one call. Each entry in details is an object with any of first_name, last_name, name, email, hashed_email, organization_name, domain, id, linkedin_url. Same credit rules as enrich_person, charged per matched person; does not save contacts.
enrich_people_bulk.notes: Consumes Apollo credits per matched person.

details.description: Up to 10 people, each e.g. {"email": "jo@acme.com"} or {"first_name": "Jo", "last_name": "Blake", "domain": "acme.com"}.

reveal_personal_emails.description: Also return personal emails (consumes credits; not available for GDPR regions).

reveal_phone_number.description: Also return phone numbers including mobiles; delivered asynchronously to webhook_url or by polling. Consumes credits.

run_waterfall_email.description: Run email waterfall enrichment across third-party sources (async).

run_waterfall_phone.description: Run phone waterfall enrichment across third-party sources (async).

webhook_url.description: Where Apollo posts phone/waterfall results; required with reveal_phone_number unless poll_only is true.

poll_only.description: Receive phone/waterfall results by polling get_webhook_result with the returned request_id instead of a webhook.

get_person.title: Get complete person info
get_person.description: Fetch the complete Apollo record for one person by Apollo person id: employment history, location and full current organization details. Costs 1 credit per person. Use search_people to find ids.

get_webhook_result.title: Poll an enrichment result
get_webhook_result.description: Fetch the payload of an asynchronous phone or waterfall enrichment by the request_id returned from enrich_person or enrich_people_bulk - use it with poll_only, or when the webhook callback was missed. Returns the webhook status and result.

request_id.description: The request_id returned by the enrichment call (a signed 64-bit integer, as text).

search_organizations.title: Search organizations
search_organizations.description: Search Apollo's database of companies by name, domain, location, headcount, revenue, technologies, keywords, funding, job postings and headcount growth. Costs 1 credit per page (up to 100 results). Use search_accounts for companies already saved to your team.

organization_name.description: Company name to match (partial name matches).

organization_domains.description: Company domains without www. or @, up to 1,000.

not_organization_domains.description: Exclude companies with any of these domains.

organization_locations.description: Headquarters locations to include: cities, US states, countries.

technologies_any.description: Technology uids the company uses, e.g. ["salesforce"] (underscores for spaces).

keyword_tags.description: Industry or keyword tags, e.g. ["mining", "sales strategy"].

latest_funding_min.description: Minimum amount of the most recent funding round.

latest_funding_max.description: Maximum amount of the most recent funding round.

total_funding_min.description: Minimum total funding across all rounds.

total_funding_max.description: Maximum total funding across all rounds.

latest_funding_after.description: Earliest date of the most recent funding round, YYYY-MM-DD.

latest_funding_before.description: Latest date of the most recent funding round, YYYY-MM-DD.

job_posting_titles.description: Job titles in the company's active job postings.

job_posting_locations.description: Locations of the company's active job postings.

num_jobs_min.description: Minimum number of active job postings.

num_jobs_max.description: Maximum number of active job postings.

headcount_growth_months.description: Window for headcount growth: 6, 12 or 24 months.

headcount_growth_min.description: Minimum headcount growth over the window, whole percent.

headcount_growth_max.description: Maximum headcount growth over the window, whole percent.

lookalike_organization_ids.description: Organization ids to use as lookalike seeds.

output.description: Matching organizations (and matching saved accounts) with pagination.

enrich_organization.title: Enrich an organization
enrich_organization.description: Look up one company by domain, LinkedIn URL or website (name improves accuracy) and return its enriched profile: industry, headcount, revenue, funding, technologies, locations and more. Costs 1 credit. Use enrich_organizations_bulk for up to 10.

domain.description: Company domain without www. or @, e.g. apollo.io.

name.description: Company name, to improve match accuracy alongside another identifier.

enrich_organizations_bulk.title: Bulk enrich organizations
enrich_organizations_bulk.description: Enrich up to 10 companies in one call. Give details as objects with any of domain, linkedin_url, name, website; or just a list of domains. Costs 1 credit per company.

details.description: Up to 10 companies, e.g. [{"domain": "apollo.io"}, {"name": "Acme", "website": "https://acme.com"}]. Takes precedence over domains.

domains.description: Company domains to match by domain only, up to 10.

get_organization.title: Get complete organization info
get_organization.description: Fetch the complete Apollo record for one company by Apollo organization id, including departmental headcount, funding events and technologies. Costs 1 credit. Find ids with search_organizations.

list_organization_job_postings.title: List organization job postings
list_organization_job_postings.description: List a company's current job postings by Apollo organization id - title, location, URL and posting date. Costs 1 credit per page (up to 10,000 per page).

search_news_articles.title: Search company news
search_news_articles.description: Find news articles about specific companies by Apollo organization id, optionally by category (e.g. hires, investment, contract) and publish date range. Costs 1 credit per page (up to 25 results).

organization_ids.description: Apollo organization ids to get news for.

create_contact.title: Create a contact
create_contact.description: Save a person as a contact in your team's Apollo account. Apollo does not dedupe unless run_dedupe is true, in which case a match is updated in place. Returns the contact. Use bulk_create_contacts for up to 100, and enrich_person first if you need their email.

account_id.description: Apollo account id to link the contact to.

label_names.description: Names of lists the contact belongs to.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id, e.g. {"60c39ed82bd02f01154c470a": "2025-08-07"}.

run_dedupe.description: Match existing contacts (by email, name, etc.) and update instead of creating a duplicate.

update_contact.title: Update a contact
update_contact.description: Update fields on an existing contact by id: name, title, employer, email, phones, stage, account, lists (label_names replaces them) and custom fields. Only the fields you pass change.

account_id.description: Apollo account id to link the contact to.

label_names.description: Replaces the lists the contact belongs to.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id, e.g. {"60c39ed82bd02f01154c470a": "2025-08-07"}.

get_contact.title: View a contact
get_contact.description: Fetch one saved contact by Apollo contact id, with emails, phones, stage, owner, account and custom fields. Use search_contacts to find ids.

search_contacts.title: Search contacts
search_contacts.description: Search the contacts saved in your team's Apollo account by keywords (name, title, employer, email), stage and list, with sorting. Consumes no credits. Up to 100 per page, 500 pages. Use search_people for net-new prospects.

q_keywords.description: Keywords: names, titles, employers or emails.

bulk_create_contacts.title: Bulk create contacts
bulk_create_contacts.description: Create up to 100 contacts in one request with deduplication; returns created_contacts and existing_contacts separately. Each contact object takes first_name, last_name, email, title, organization_name, phone, account_id, contact_stage_id, linkedin_url, typed_custom_fields and more.

append_label_names.description: List names to add every contact in the request to.

owner_id.description: Owner user id for all contacts; defaults to the current user.

run_dedupe.description: Full deduplication across all sources, returning existing contacts instead of duplicating.

bulk_update_contacts.title: Bulk update contacts
bulk_update_contacts.description: Update many contacts at once: either apply the same values (owner_id, title, account_id, custom fields...) to every id in contact_ids, or give per-contact changes in contact_attributes (each with an id). Runs async above 100 contacts.

contact_ids.description: Contact ids to apply the same values to.

owner_id.description: With contact_ids: owner user id for all.

organization_name.description: With contact_ids: employer name for all.

title.description: With contact_ids: job title for all.

first_name.description: With contact_ids: first name for all.

last_name.description: With contact_ids: last name for all.

account_id.description: With contact_ids: account id for all.

linkedin_url.description: With contact_ids: LinkedIn URL for all.

typed_custom_fields.description: With contact_ids: custom field values for all, keyed by field id.

output.description: Updated contacts, or a job when async.

update_contact_stages.title: Update contact stage in bulk
update_contact_stages.description: Move one or more contacts to a contact stage. Get stage ids from list_contact_stages.

update_contact_owners.title: Update contact owner in bulk
update_contact_owners.description: Assign one or more contacts to a different owner (a user in your team; ids from list_users).

list_contact_stages.title: List contact stages
list_contact_stages.description: List the contact stages configured for your team, with their ids - needed for create_contact, update_contact_stages and search filters.

list_contact_deals.title: List a contact's deals
list_contact_deals.description: List the deals (opportunities) associated with one contact.

create_account.title: Create an account
create_account.description: Save a company as an account in your team's Apollo account. No deduplication is applied - search_accounts first, or use bulk_create_accounts with run_dedupe.

domain.description: Company domain without www., e.g. apollo.io.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id.

update_account.title: Update an account
update_account.description: Update an existing account by id: name, domain, owner, stage, phone, address and custom fields. Only the fields you pass change.

domain.description: Company domain without www., e.g. apollo.io.

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id.

get_account.title: View an account
get_account.description: Fetch one saved account by Apollo account id, with owner, stage, domain and custom fields.

search_accounts.title: Search accounts
search_accounts.description: Search the accounts (companies) saved in your team's Apollo account by name keywords, stage and list, with sorting. Consumes no credits. Up to 100 per page. Use search_organizations for net-new companies.

q_organization_name.description: Keywords matching part of an account name.

bulk_create_accounts.title: Bulk create accounts
bulk_create_accounts.description: Create up to 100 accounts in one request with deduplication; returns created_accounts and existing_accounts. Each object takes name, domain, owner_id, phone, raw_address, linkedin_url, organization_id, account_stage_id, typed_custom_fields and CRM ids.

append_label_names.description: List names to add every account in the request to.

run_dedupe.description: Also match existing accounts by domain, organization_id and name (default matches only CRM ids).

bulk_update_accounts.title: Bulk update accounts
bulk_update_accounts.description: Update many accounts at once: apply the same name/owner/stage to every id in account_ids, or give per-account changes in account_attributes (each with an id, plus name, owner_id, account_stage_id, typed_custom_fields).

account_ids.description: Account ids to apply the same values to.

owner_id.description: With account_ids: owner user id for all.

account_stage_id.description: With account_ids: account stage id for all.

update_account_owners.title: Update account owner in bulk
update_account_owners.description: Assign one or more accounts to a different owner (a user in your team; ids from list_users).

list_account_stages.title: List account stages
list_account_stages.description: List the account stages configured for your team, with their ids - needed for create_account, bulk updates and search filters.

create_deal.title: Create a deal
create_deal.description: Create a deal (opportunity) with a name and optional owner, account, amount, stage, close date and custom fields.

owner_id.description: Deal owner's user id, from list_users.

account_id.description: Account id of the company the deal targets.

amount.description: Deal value with no commas or currency symbol, e.g. "55123478".

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id.

update_deal.title: Update a deal
update_deal.description: Update an existing deal by id: name, owner, amount, stage, close date and custom fields. Only the fields you pass change.

owner_id.description: Deal owner's user id, from list_users.

amount.description: Deal value with no commas or currency symbol, e.g. "55123478".

typed_custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field id.

get_deal.title: View a deal
get_deal.description: Fetch one deal by id: owner, amount, stage, account, close date and custom fields.

list_deals.title: List deals
list_deals.description: List every deal in your team's Apollo account, paginated, optionally sorted by amount, closed or won first.

list_deal_stages.title: List deal stages
list_deal_stages.description: List the deal (opportunity) stages configured for your team, with ids - needed for create_deal and update_deal.

search_sequences.title: Search sequences
search_sequences.description: Search the sequences (emailer campaigns) in your team's Apollo account by name keywords. Returns ids, status and stats - needed for add_contacts_to_sequence.

q_name.description: Keywords matching part of a sequence name.

add_contacts_to_sequence.title: Add contacts to a sequence
add_contacts_to_sequence.description: Enroll contacts in a sequence, sending from one or more linked mailboxes (ids from list_email_accounts). Identify contacts by contact_ids or by list names. Safety flags let you include contacts with no/unverified email, job changes, or already in other sequences. Contacts start receiving steps once the sequence is active.

send_email_from_email_account_ids.description: Email account id(s) to send from; several rotate mailboxes.

contact_ids.description: Contact ids to add. Either this or label_names is required.

label_names.description: List names whose contacts to add, instead of contact_ids.

send_email_from_email_address.description: Specific address to send from within the email account.

sequence_no_email.description: Add contacts even without an email address.

sequence_job_change.description: Add contacts who recently changed jobs.

sequence_active_in_other_campaigns.description: Add contacts already in other sequences.

sequence_finished_in_other_campaigns.description: Add contacts finished in another sequence.

sequence_same_company_in_same_campaign.description: Add contacts even if colleagues are already in this sequence.

contacts_without_ownership_permission.description: Add contacts you lack ownership permission for.

add_if_in_queue.description: Add contacts currently queued for processing.

user_id.description: User recorded as having added the contacts.

auto_unpause_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime to auto-unpause contacts added with status paused.

output.description: Added contacts, skipped ids and the sequence.

update_sequence_contact_status.title: Remove or stop contacts in sequences
update_sequence_contact_status.description: Change the status of contacts across one or more sequences: mark_as_finished, stop (halt progress), or remove them from the sequences entirely.

contact_ids.description: Contact ids whose status to change.

mode.description: What to do with the contacts.

output.description: A progress job for the update.

get_contact_sequence_activity.title: Get contact sequence activity
get_contact_sequence_activity.description: Get one contact's sequence timeline: when they were added, emails sent, opens, clicks, replies, pauses and finishes - across all sequences or one.

create_sequence.title: Create a sequence
create_sequence.description: Create a sequence with its steps and email templates. Each emailer_steps entry has type (e.g. auto_email, manual_email, call, action_item, linkedin_step_*), wait_time, wait_mode, and emailer_touches holding the email template (subject, body_html). Created inactive unless active is true.

label_names.description: Labels (folders) to apply to the sequence.

max_emails_per_day.description: Maximum emails the sequence sends per day.

same_account_reply_delay_days.description: Days to pause other contacts at the same account after a reply (max 1000).

folder_id.description: Folder id to place the sequence in.

sequence_by_exact_daytime.description: Schedule steps at exact datetimes (exact_datetime per step) instead of wait intervals.

mark_finished_if_click.description: Finish contacts when they click a link.

days_to_wait_before_mark_as_response.description: Days after which an incoming email no longer counts as a response.

create_task_if_email_open.description: Create a task when a contact opens emails enough times.

ignore_apollo_global_email_bounce_list.description: Send even to addresses on Apollo's global bounce list.

sequence_ruleset_id.description: Existing sequence ruleset id to apply.

output.description: The created sequence, steps, touches and templates.

update_sequence.title: Update a sequence
update_sequence.description: Update a sequence by id: name, on/off, owner, schedule, labels, daily cap, CC/BCC, sharing, and steps. Passing emailer_steps replaces the step list - steps not included are removed; include a step's id to keep and update it.

active.description: Turn the sequence on (true) or off (false).

user_id.description: Reassign the sequence to this owner user id.

label_names.description: Labels (folders) to apply to the sequence.

max_emails_per_day.description: Maximum emails the sequence sends per day.

same_account_reply_delay_days.description: Days to pause other contacts at the same account after a reply (max 1000).

cc_emails.description: Comma-separated addresses to CC on sequence emails.

bcc_emails.description: Comma-separated addresses to BCC on sequence emails.

emailer_steps.description: The full ordered step list; omitted existing steps are deleted.

activate_sequence.title: Activate a sequence
activate_sequence.description: Start an inactive sequence so enrolled contacts begin receiving steps. Use deactivate_sequence to pause it.

deactivate_sequence.title: Deactivate a sequence
deactivate_sequence.description: Stop an active sequence, pausing all contact activity in it. Reactivate with activate_sequence.

archive_sequence.title: Archive a sequence
archive_sequence.description: Archive a sequence: marks it inactive and finishes every contact in it. Prefer deactivate_sequence to pause it reversibly.

list_email_schedules.title: List email sending schedules
list_email_schedules.description: List the sending schedules (days and times sequences send) configured for your team, with ids for create_sequence and update_sequence.

search_outreach_emails.title: Search outreach emails
search_outreach_emails.description: Search emails your team created or sent through Apollo sequences, by status, reply sentiment, sender, sequence, date range, not-sent reason and keywords. Multi-value filters here take one value each because Apollo reads them from the query string.

emailer_message_stat.description: Email status: delivered, scheduled, drafted, not_opened, opened, clicked, unsubscribed, demoed, bounced, spam_blocked, failed_other.

reply_class.description: Reply sentiment: willing_to_meet, follow_up_question, person_referral, out_of_office, already_left_company_or_not_right_person, not_interested, unsubscribe, none_of_the_above.

user_id.description: Only emails sent by this user id.

sequence_id.description: Only emails in this sequence id.

not_sequence_id.description: Exclude emails in this sequence id.

date_range_mode.description: Which date the range applies to.

date_min.description: Range start, YYYY-MM-DD; use with date_range_mode.

date_max.description: Range end, YYYY-MM-DD; use with date_range_mode.

not_sent_reason.description: Not-sent reason code, e.g. email_unverified, contact_stage_safeguard, gdpr_compliance.

get_email_content.title: Get sent email content
get_email_content.description: Fetch the subject, body and recipients of up to 10 emails your team already sent, as plain text or original HTML.

create_email_draft.title: Create an email draft
create_email_draft.description: Create an unsent email draft to a contact (or as a reply to an existing Apollo email). Does not send - call send_email_now with the returned id. Recipients entries set to/cc/bcc: {"email": ..., "recipient_type_cd": "to"|"cc"|"bcc"}.

contact_id.description: Recipient contact id; required unless in_response_to_emailer_message_id is given.

in_response_to_emailer_message_id.description: Id of an Apollo email this draft replies to.

enable_tracking.description: Enable open and click tracking if your team allows it.

outreach_task_id.description: Outreach task id to associate the draft with.

send_email_now.title: Send an email now
send_email_now.description: Immediately send an existing drafted, scheduled or failed Apollo email by id. Sending is asynchronous - confirm with check_email_send_status.

email_id.description: Email message id, e.g. from create_email_draft.

check_email_send_status.title: Check email send status
check_email_send_status.description: Check the delivery status of an Apollo email after send_email_now: status, completion time and any not-sent or failure reason.

failure_reason.description: Why it failed, if it did.

create_task.title: Create a task
create_task.description: Create one task for a user to act on a contact - a call, manual email, LinkedIn step or generic action item - with a due time, priority and note. Use bulk_create_tasks for the same task on many contacts.

status.description: Task status: scheduled for future tasks, completed or skipped for past ones.

due_at.description: Due datetime, ISO 8601 (GMT unless offset given), e.g. 2025-02-15T08:10:30Z.

note.description: Task description giving the owner context.

bulk_create_tasks.title: Bulk create tasks
bulk_create_tasks.description: Create the same task for many contacts at once - one task per contact id, all owned by one user with one type, due time, priority and note.

contact_ids.description: Contacts to create a task for each.

get_task.title: Get a task
get_task.description: Fetch the full details of one task by id: type, status, owner, contact, due time, priority and note.

update_task.title: Update a task
update_task.description: Change an existing task: owner, contact, type, priority, due time, title, note or call script. Most fields only apply to scheduled tasks; use complete_task or skip_task to close one.

creator_id.description: User considered the task's creator (scheduled tasks).

priority.description: Priority; a scheduled task resets to medium if omitted.

call_script.description: Call script or talking points for a call task.

complete_task.title: Complete a task
complete_task.description: Mark a task completed, optionally recording a note about the outcome.

skip_task.title: Skip a task
skip_task.description: Mark a task skipped without completing it, optionally with a note explaining why.

on_task_page.description: Reindex synchronously so search reflects the change immediately.

search_tasks.title: Search tasks
search_tasks.description: List tasks your team created in Apollo, sorted by due date or priority, optionally with counts per task type. Up to 100 per page, 500 pages.

open_factor_names.description: Pass ["task_types"] to get a count of tasks per type.

create_call_record.title: Log a call
create_call_record.description: Log a call made in an outside dialer (e.g. Orum, Nooks) as an Apollo call record, with caller, contact, account, numbers, status, times, duration, purpose, outcome and note. Does not dial anyone.

logged.description: Create an individual record for the call in Apollo.

user_ids.description: Caller user id(s) in your team.

account_id.description: Account to associate with the call.

update_call_record.title: Update a call record
update_call_record.description: Update an existing Apollo call record by id: status, times, duration, purpose, outcome, note, contact or account.

logged.description: Create an individual record for the call in Apollo.

user_ids.description: Caller user id(s) in your team.

account_id.description: Account to associate with the call.

search_calls.title: Search calls
search_calls.description: Search calls your team made or received with Apollo's dialer (or logged), by date range, duration, direction, user, contact label, purpose, outcome and keywords. Multi-value filters take one value each because Apollo reads them from the query string.

user_id.description: Only calls involving this user id.

contact_label_id.description: Only calls with contacts in this label id.

phone_call_purpose_id.description: Only calls with this purpose id.

phone_call_outcome_id.description: Only calls with this outcome id.

search_conversations.title: Search conversations
search_conversations.description: Search recorded conversations (video meetings and dialer calls) by type, account, contacts, labels, trackers, organizations, date range and scorecard.

enforce_contact_boundary.description: Restrict to conversations visible to the given contacts.

get_conversation.title: Get a conversation
get_conversation.description: Fetch one conversation by id: topic, time, duration, host, participants, accounts and AI insights. Costs 1 credit if it has AI insights.
get_conversation.notes: Consumes 1 Apollo credit when the conversation has AI insights.

export_conversations.title: Export conversations
export_conversations.description: Start an export of conversations in a time range; a team member is emailed when it is ready. Poll with get_conversations_export using the returned export_id. Costs 1 credit per conversation with AI insights.
export_conversations.notes: Consumes 1 Apollo credit per conversation with AI insights.

get_conversations_export.title: Get a conversations export
get_conversations_export.description: Get the download URL for a conversations export started with export_conversations.

list_notes.title: List notes
list_notes.description: List notes attached to a contact, account, deal, calendar event or conversation, sorted and paginated with skip/limit (max 100). Give at least one of the id filters.

start_date.description: Only notes created on or after, YYYY-MM-DD.

list_lists.title: List all lists
list_lists.description: List every list (label) in your Apollo account - contact, account and sequence lists - with ids and names.

create_list.title: Create a list
create_list.description: Create a new, empty contact or account list. Add records with add_records_to_lists.

book_of_business.description: Mark an account list as a Book of Business list.

update_list.title: Update a list
update_list.description: Rename a list or toggle its Book of Business flag. A list's modality cannot change.

add_records_to_lists.title: Add records to lists
add_records_to_lists.description: Add existing contacts or accounts to one or more lists by list name; names that don't exist yet are created.

remove_records_from_lists.title: Remove records from lists
remove_records_from_lists.description: Remove contacts or accounts from one or more lists by list name. The records themselves are kept.

list_fields.title: List fields
list_fields.description: List fields in your Apollo account - system, custom or CRM-synced - with ids, labels, modality and types. Custom field ids are the keys for typed_custom_fields.

list_custom_fields.title: List custom fields (legacy)
list_custom_fields.description: List all custom fields with ids and types. Deprecated by Apollo - prefer list_fields with source custom.

create_custom_field.title: Create a custom field
create_custom_field.description: Create a custom field on contacts, accounts or deals, of type string, textarea, number, date, datetime or boolean.

update_custom_field.title: Update a custom field
update_custom_field.description: Update one existing field by id: rename it, change a text field's max length, or edit picklist values (via meta). Only the parameters you include change.

field_group_id.description: Field group id to move it to.

meta.description: Type-specific settings, e.g. {"max_length": 500} or picklist values.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List the users in your team's Apollo account with their ids - needed for owner_id and user_id elsewhere.

get_current_user.title: Get current user profile
get_current_user.description: Get the profile of the user the API key or OAuth token acts as - id, team, name, email - optionally with credit usage and remaining credits. Consumes no credits; a good connection check.

include_credit_usage.description: Include credit usage and remaining credits.

list_email_accounts.title: List email accounts
list_email_accounts.description: List the mailboxes your teammates have linked to Apollo, with ids - needed for add_contacts_to_sequence.

get_api_usage_stats.title: View API usage and rate limits
get_api_usage_stats.description: Show your team's Apollo API usage and the per-minute, per-hour and per-day rate limits for each endpoint.

output.description: Usage and limits keyed by endpoint.

get_credit_usage_stats.title: View credit usage
get_credit_usage_stats.description: Show your team's credit balance for each credit type in the current billing cycle: limit, consumed and left over.

output.description: Credit usage by type and the current cycle.

query_analytics_report.title: Query an analytics report
query_analytics_report.description: Query Apollo Analytics for aggregated sales activity (emails sent, replies, calls, meetings, deals...) - flat totals, grouped by one dimension, or pivoted. See Apollo's Metrics and Dimensions Reference for valid metric names and group_by dimensions.

date_range.description: Date range preset; custom_range needs smart_datetime_range {min,max} in filters.

group_by.description: Row dimension, at most one: [{"name": "smart_user_id"}]; pass [] for flat totals.

sorts.description: Sort, at most one: [{"asc": false, "metric": {...same as a metrics entry}}]; pass [] for default.

pivot_group_by.description: Column dimension for a pivot table, at most one.

skip_group_by_values.description: Dimension values to exclude from rows.

output.description: The report rows and any incompatible filters.
